the NEW structural-health composition (Phase 3F.1.5.R sub-task 3) - primary focus per the certification charter

structuralHealthAdversarialConstruction.requirement: Build a case where a unique amendment target exists structurally (targetResolutionStatus === UNIQUE) BUT the target node is independently flagged unhealthy by healthDiagnostics() (an ERROR-severity finding), and verify with a real executed test that the result FAILS CLOSED.
structuralHealthAdversarialConstruction.construction1: A DEFINITION-kind provision (not SECTION - an untested branch of resolveBaseText as of this session) whose declaring physical occurrence carries an INVALID_SOURCE_SPAN ERROR finding, targeted by a real, dated, resolved amendment effect with captured newText.
structuralHealthAdversarialConstruction.result1: targetResolutionStatus=UNIQUE (the definition genuinely, uniquely resolves) AND structuralHealthStatus=STRUCTURAL_HEALTH_UNSAFE. currentText=null (never derived from the corrupted occurrence). attemptedText preserved (what the amendment says stays visible). status=OPERATIVE_STATE_PARTIAL. reviewRequired=true. FAILS CLOSED as required.
structuralHealthAdversarialConstruction.construction2: A different ERROR-severity finding code entirely (OVERLAPPING_INCOMPATIBLE_SPAN via a genuinely mis-nested parent/child pair - every individual span independently 'valid' but the declared nesting relationship is structurally impossible), on a SECTION-kind target, to prove the composition is not narrowly wired to one specific health-finding code.
structuralHealthAdversarialConstruction.result2: Same fail-closed outcome: targetResolutionStatus=UNIQUE, structuralHealthStatus=STRUCTURAL_HEALTH_UNSAFE, currentText=null, status=OPERATIVE_STATE_PARTIAL.
structuralHealthAdversarialConstruction.negativeControl: The same DEFINITION-kind construction with a HEALTHY declaring node produces STRUCTURAL_HEALTH_SUFFICIENT, OPERATIVE_STATE_RESOLVED, and a populated currentText - no false positive on ordinary, uncorrupted definitions.
structuralHealthAdversarialConstruction.verdict: FAIL-CLOSED CONFIRMED via real, executed tests (not a thought experiment) across two independent constructions and two distinct ERROR-severity finding codes, on both SECTION and DEFINITION provision kinds. No BLOCKER - the fix genuinely generalizes beyond the single scenario the prior phase's own regression test covers.

p1_4ReverificationAndOverSuppressionChec.construction: Independent drafting language, different from the original fix's own regression test: 'This Amendment shall become effective as of March 1, 2025, upon satisfaction of the conditions set forth in Section 9 hereof (the date such conditions are satisfied, the "Amendment Effective Date")' - and a reversed-order variant (conditional language BEFORE the explicit date in the same clause).
p1_4ReverificationAndOverSuppressionChec.result: Both resolve CONDITIONAL_UNRESOLVED, date=null - the explicit date is correctly never treated as a settled, unconditional effective date.
p1_4ReverificationAndOverSuppressionChec.overSuppressionPositiveControl: Architecture Invariant #34 ('too strict fails falsely safe, not safe') explicitly re-tested: a genuinely unconditional explicit date, with UNRELATED conditions-precedent language appearing in a separate, later sentence about a different subject (an Incremental Facility funding condition), still resolves EXPLICIT_EFFECTIVE_DATE - the fix does not over-suppress.
p1_4ReverificationAndOverSuppressionChec.verdict: P1-4 CONFIRMED, with an explicit over-suppression check the prior phase's own regression test did not include.
